Water industry / nationalisation, 7 August 2026:
- Taking England's water industry into public ownership would cost around £140bn, the Burnham government has been warned, according to analysts cited on 7 Aug.
- Public anger over sewage discharges, bills, dividends, executive pay and company debt has fuelled demands to return the sector to public hands.
- Critics warn a £140bn buyout would be unaffordable for a stretched government and would divert money from cleaning up the pipes; a majority of England's rivers are failing environmental tests.
- The question falls to the Chancellor ahead of the autumn Budget.
